name: msp-itsm-platform
description: Enterprise MSP Service Management Platform: ITSM, Helpdesk, Asset Management, CMDB

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,worker -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev:worker -w apps/api"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint:ui
